title: What Is a Stop Loss and How to Set One
description: A stop loss is an order that closes your trade at a set price to limit loss. Learn how it works and how to place one.
body:
## What is a stop loss

A stop loss is an order that sells your position when the price falls to a level you choose.

## How to set a stop loss

- Pick your entry price
- Decide the maximum loss you accept
- Place the stop below a recent support level

title: How SIP Works in Mutual Funds
description: A SIP invests a fixed amount in a mutual fund every month. See how it works, its benefits and how units are allotted.
body:
## What is a SIP

A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) invests a fixed amount at regular intervals.

## Why people use it

- Small monthly amounts
- Rupee cost averaging
- Builds a habit

title: IPO Allotment Process Explained
description: Learn how IPO shares are allotted, what happens when an issue is oversubscribed and how to check your allotment status.
body:
## How allotment works

When an IPO is oversubscribed, shares are allotted by lottery for retail applicants.

## How to check status

- Open the registrar website
- Enter your PAN or application number
